question: What is academic misconduct?
retrieved_source: BUE_Student_Academic_Handbook_2026-27 p.32; BUE_Student_Academic_Handbook_2026-27 p.32; 19_Academic Misconduct Procedure - Copy 1 p.6
answer:
Academic misconduct occurs when a student gains, or attempts to gain, an unfair academic advantage or does not follow the University’s requirements for academic work or assessment. [Source 1, BUE_Student_Academic_Handbook_2026-27, Page 32]

Additionally, academic misconduct is described as occurring when a student does not work honestly, acknowledge the sources and ideas they use, and follow the requirements set for each assessment. [Source 2, BUE_Student_Academic_Handbook_2026-27, Page 32]

It is not specified in the provided documents what are the exact types of conduct that may be considered academic misconduct, but examples include plagiarism. [Source 1, BUE_Student_Academic_Handbook_2026-27, Page 32]
